name: wkf-online
description: Web application for Wroclawski Klub Fantastyki

scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-host NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" next build --webpack
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-host NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.dev:container: cross-env NODE_ENV=development NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-container NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.prepare:e2e: pnpm prepare:integration && cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=true DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=test.env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --require dotenv/config" tsx ./scripts/seed.ts
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-host NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next start
scripts.test:e2e:ci: pnpm prepare:e2e && cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_OVERRIDE=true DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=test.env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-e2e-ci PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_EXISTING_SERVER=false PLAYWRIGHT_WEB_SERVER_COMMAND="./node_modules/.bin/cross-env NODE_ENV=development NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --port 3100" NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --require dotenv/config --import=tsx/esm" playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --workers=1
scripts.test:integration: pnpm prepare:integration && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mts tests/integration --maxWorkers=1
